_doc: ONE source of truth for per-format defaults (v3.7, 2026-11-14). Read by tools/format_preset.py, pacing.py, hype_lint.py, grade_check.py, qa_gate.py. Evidence tags: measured = numbers we measured on reference videos; inferred = our reading/convention; UNVERIFIED = not confirmed by a render or a listen. Sources: docs/research/{NARRATION_HYPE,MUSIC_RESEARCH,REF_IG_Dfe8B5Hs3G6,REF_IG_Dfs43n3oWqx,GEMINI_AUDIO_NOTES}.md. | v5.1 2026-11-18: in_this_world tiers/length/cta/tts/tempo updated from owner decisions (tiers corrected: short 80-120 s, long = ~20 min compilation). | v6.0 2026-11-19 (owner: 'implement everything the viral videos do'): tiers full 100-165 s / lite 60-78 s, script_v3, narration_v3 (Adam + D FX everywhere, flow edit, EARS targets), package_v6. Rules: docs/VIRAL_V6.md. The weekly self-learning run may re-measure these numbers (3+ new outliers) and logs every change in LESSONS + CHANGELOG. | v6.1 2026-11-20: narration_house (the owner-approved 'v3' house narration, tools/ep_audio/narrate_house.py) for every format; ears targets recalibrated to include the owner-approved reference.
